View of Lower Manhattan Island From An Aeromarine
AERIAL SIGHTSEEING FLIGHTS OVER NEW YORK
Flight No. 1.-The $10.00 Flight leaves 82nd Street and flies up the
Hudson to about Grant's Tomb and down around the Battery circling the
Statue of Liberty. This affords a wonderful view of the city with its architec-
tural wonders, the Palisades and the Ramapo Mountains of New Jersey.
Flight No. 2.-The $25.00 Flight makes a complete circuit of the Island
of Manhattan; flying down the Hudson around the Battery and Statue of
Liberty, up the East River past Hell Gate, the Bronx, and then down the
Hudson River.
All of the 10,000 passengers who have flown in our boats in
safety and comfort comment enthusiastically on the dependa-
bility of the Aeromarine organization.
You see more on a few minutes' flight than you could in a year of ordinary
travel, while having the assurance of being absolutely safe.
